g.text: v1 | threshold = 0.5 | each model's own successful samples (not paired)
N/A = missing result, no successful predictions, undefined metric, or no aligned complete timing log.
PII is ordinary binary classification (PII present vs absent), not extraction or masking quality.
PII datasets contain positives only; AUROC is undefined.
Latency = logged end-to-end elapsed / all processed rows, including failed requests; not pure inference time.
Successful sample sets can differ between models; use the paired baseline for fair quality comparisons.
